question: The Battle of Chausa between Humayun and Sher Shah Suri was fought in the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1539**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Battle of Chausa was a significant military engagement that took place on June 26, 1539,
 
 
• between the Mughal Emperor Humayun and the Afghan warlord Sher Shah Suri.
 
 
 
• The battle, fought near Chausa in Bihar, India, resulted in a decisive victory for Sher Shah Suri.
 
• This defeat forced Humayun to flee to Persia, marking a significant setback for the Mughal Empire.
 
• Sher Shah Suri, on the other hand, established the Sur Empire, which briefly ruled over much of North India.
 
• His administrative reforms and military prowess had a lasting impact on the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Humayun:
 
 
• He was the second Mughal emperor, succeeding his father, Babur.
 
• He suffered a significant defeat at the Battle of Chausa against Sher Shah Suri, leading to his exile.
 
• Despite setbacks, he eventually regained power and re-established the Mughal Empire.
 
 
 
• Sher Shah Suri:
 
 
• He was an Afghan ruler who established the Sur Empire in India.
 
• He was a skilled military leader and administrator, known for his strategic abilities.
 
• He introduced several administrative reforms, including the standardization of currency and the construction of a network of roads.
